Saniku gapirmasa bo'ladi, o'zingni hafa qildirib qo'ymasang, gapingni o'tkizishdan uyog'iga bormay qolding and i don't even know how to explain why I haven't texted you today. sani soginmaganligim yoki yozgim kemaganidanmas. I do. More than you probably ever realise. yana har doimgidek aytganimdek i am keep getting hurt by your little texts that probably means nothig to you. va eng o'gir botadigani esa ularniyam umuman sezmiydigan bo'lib qolgansan. I miss how you used to notice the little changes in me, how you could tell when something was wrong without me having to explain everything. I don't want to keep asking for things that used to come naturally, i never wanted to and i hope i will never want to. good night. 00:45.

Bugun yozmoqchiydim. Kechayam yozmoqchiydim. But I keep stopping myself because I don't know what I'm supposed to say anymore. Sometimes I feel like I'm the only one who's afraid of losing what we have. balkim notogri oylavotgandurman, lekin that's genuinely how I've been feeling. I hate that I've started questioning whether you miss me as much as I miss you, soginganingni qanchalik ko'p etsang ham negadir ularni rostanam ichingdan aytayotganga oxshamiysan. I don't want to feel like I'm asking you to care about me. I just wish things were different between us. i just wish my little girl would not be who she is rn, i just want here back to who she used to be

Bugun nima deyishniyam bilmiyman, just another day. Shu kunlada hayotdan maqsadim qolmagan togrisi. shu kunim otsa bir amallab tirik qolib qornimni toygazsam boldi. Shu mana oqishdan chiqdi tel qisammikan diyman, qolim bormiydi. balkim hech nima demaslik sani baxtli qilar. balkim sani man ozgartirgandirman. balkim sani umuman tushunmayotgandirman. lekin shu tushunishni doim togri tushunishni xohliyman. i miss having you around, i miss looking at you in class and just blow a kiss. I wish you would understand how sometimes i feel miserable and want you to come without having me to be the one who always has to take the step. i really wish you would understand that and what makes me so sad is that i already told you that before so many times. bir nima bo'lar. hayrli tun. 11:52.

you can't imagine how much i hate my phone now. i wish i had nothing in my phone to us and u would be beside me just to approach when i am feeling like i am dying. i have been studying hard but i have failed my physics exam twice already. i dont know how my dad would be dissapointed at me by hearing that. i just wish i would be a bit smarter to make them proud. i just wish how life was as easy as it used to be. everyone is just going down and i can't even imagine how deep it might go. i just want to sleep and wish seeing you in my dreams. good night. 22:19.

Why don't you think about me. why. I always begged and asked for attention because i always lacked attention. I started social media because i wanted attention. I wanted to be famous because i wanted attention. I wish in this life there would be someone that would understand me except my parents. I wish i will find somebody that will actually trust me rather than doubt at me every single day. I wish somebody will actually care about me and my feelings. I wish, i really wish. I wish I had somebody to talk with. I wish somebody could understand me. I wish i had my mom or my dad to hug or anyone i truly love. I truly loved her, tried all my best to always keep her happy but i guess i am not her type, i guess i am not enough to be with her. I know it's not a big deal there are millions of girls out there but the most sad part is that i am always the one nobody trusts, i am the one who always gets treated shit.

I really wish nobody would ever break my heart again like that. I never thought somebody i trusted the most, somebody I loved the most would leave me like that. What did i do to deserve to hear all of that. Nega hamma alamini mandan olishi kerak. nega men. nega men kimningdir travmasini deb javob berishim kerak. why don't i deserve to be happy, why i dont deserve to be loved. I am simply a 17 year old little kid with big dreams and the only desire to make his family proud. 

Unga hech nima yomonlik qilmagan bo'lsam ham xohlagan gapi bilan mani treat qildi. Uniyam tushunish mumkin. ayblamiyman, lekin manchi. man ham odammanku. nega har doim manchi deganimda ojiz insondek ozimni his qilishim kerak. Nega har doim ozimni hafa qildirib qoyishim kerak. Man hech nima yomonlik qilmagan bo'lsamam, hech nimani bilmasdan shuncha gapni gapirib tashadiya, qaniydi shu gaplarni yana bir bor o'qita olsam. kechasi soat 2:40 da ushbu habarni qanchalik ichimdan o'zimdan nafratlanib yozayotganimni bilganida edi. Qaniydi shu hamma gapirgan gaplari uchun ich ichidan pushaymon bo'lganida edi. Unga ham kimdir qilsin dimiyman, she is somebody i really loved, unga yomonlik tilamiyman, faqat shuncha gap uchun afsuslanishini xohliyman holos. I wish nobody's girlfriend treat their boyfriend like that. i don't wish that to anybody in this entire universe. 

i only wish she would have tried at least once to talk deeply with me rather than always blaming me for something. I don't even want her back. I love her so much but i will get treated like that again and i will be mad and break her heart too. and I don't want that. i dont to make her sad and i never wanted to. I just want to be loved. i only want to be seen in this world. Qanchalik yuraklarim ichlarim ogrib ketadi har doim nimadirga yoq joydan ayblanib qoyilsam. qilmagan ishim uchun javob bersam.

I am so tired and I wish i had somebody to hug right now. I just wish. Onajonim adajonim sizlarni juda ham qattiq sogindim. har kuni telefonda soraganilarda sogindinmi diganizda yuzilargan aytolmasdan ha yoga endi ozgincha boldiyu deb telefon ochganidan keyin har doim honrab yeg'lashimni bilganiylarda, aytolganimda edi. Har doim qorning toqmi deganilarda aldamasdan yoq deyolganimda edi. Yaxshi kelajak va orzularimni ushaltirish uchun sizlardan uzoqga ketishim kerak bo'lmaganida edi. 

Bu gaplarni hech kimga aytolmasdan yana ichimga yutishimni yoki shu yerga yozib qo'yishimni o'ylasam o'zimni eng keraksiz odamdek his qilaman. balki shunday hamdir, shunday bo'lib ham qolar. yozish diarycham, hech bo'lmasa meni eshitadigan sen borligingdan ham hursandman.

ichingdagini sevadigan yagona insoninga aytsangu senga shunaqa desa. Maybe my dad was always right. Ota va onangdan boshqa yaqining bo'lmaydi hech kim eshitib qo'ygin degandilar. man yo'g'a endi oshirvordila deb o'zimga ichimda aytgandim. mana yana uydagilar togri bolib chiqdi. yana bir bor kimgadur ishongandim, gapirgan gapimdan foydalanib AI ga chiqardi. ichindagini hech kim aytmaslik kereligi toppa to'g'ri gap ekan. Hozir shu gaplarimdan, yana kelajakda yana qancha gaplarimdan ozimga qarshi ishlatisharkin. Baribir xalq maqollarimiz ajoyibda. Yana bir bor nozik nuqtamdan foydalanishdi. Sevgi degan narsa shu to'ydan keyin bo'lursinakan. Qanchalik dars bo'lyapdi men uchun shu bolayotgan voqealar.

i unblocked her lekin baribir yozishga qo'lim bormadi. soginib nimadir yozgandir deb kanaliga kirsam osha yerda ham meni ketganim uchun ayblab yozibdi. Yana qayta bloklab qo'ya qoldim. O'zgarish yo'q ekan. 

Man sani orningda boganimda bunaqa qilolmasdim. Ketgan sani choiceing. Man ketmadim San ketding debdi. 

Kecha ham shuncha yozganimni o'qibdi, hech bolmasa yakunda nimadir yaxshi gap gapirsin deb ichimda yolvorib turgandim. 'ha' db qoydi holos. Ko'nglidan bittagina yaxshimisiz degan gap chiqmadi, bundan keyin ham chiqmasa kerak. Qanchalik o'zgarib ketganini haligacha tushunolmadim. Xohlagan gapini gapirdi, nima desa dedi yana ohirida sen ketding man ketmadim dedi. 

The only reason i wanted to marry early was because i wanted to be with her early. Unga bo'lgan ishonchim sevgimni shunaqa sindirib tashladi, shu qiz bilan shuncha gaplashdimmi degan gap miyyamdan ketmadi. Birinchi darsga ham, ikkinchi darsga ham bora olmadim. Uhlay ham olmadim. Na zavtrak, na obed va mana soat 7 yarim bo'ldi na ujin. shunaqa sindirib tashladi. Shunaqa odamlarga bo'lgan ishonchimni yana bir bor sindirdi. Odam asl yuzi qanday ko'rinishi qanday o'zgarishi mumkinligiga amin bo'ldim. 

Eng alam qiladigani yana mani aybladiya. Endi tushundim nega yiliga 500 mingta erkak kishi o'zini o'ldirishini tushundim. Erkaklarni barbir erkaklardan boshqa odam tushunmas ekan. hech qachon. 

Baribir ayol zoti bo'lish yaxshi. qiladigan ish yumushlarini aytmasa ancha yaxshi. Erkaklar ularni hech nima uchun sevishadi. pryam hech nima. borligi. tirikligi uchun sevishadi. Bu bilan erkakligimdan nafratlanamanmas, qaytanga shunaqa feelingsni feel qila olganimga hursandman.

2021-yil malumotlariga ko'ra daqiqasiga 1 da erkak o'z joniga qasd qilar ekan. i am not saying it is good. never said it. but nega o'ldirishadi. ichidagini hech kimga aytolmaydi, hammasini o'zi bilan carry qilib yuradi, yana bir tomondan aytishga odami ham yoq, bor bo'lsa ham foydasi yo'q o'zini aybdorga chiqarishadi. that easy. 

har doim erkaklar kuchli, emotsionalsiz, erkaklar yig'lamaydi kabi gaplar bilan o'stirib kelingan. 

Loneliness. they might have people to play football with, study with or go out with, but nobody make them feel comfortable telling that they're struggling with something. 

Pressure to succeed. Men can feel that their worth is tied with money, career, providing for their families, physical strength and achievement. When those things fall apart, they may feel they've failed as people. and this is unfortunately true. 

A man can have 20 friends, a loving family, am ambitious goals and a seemingly exciting life, yet they still feel incredibly lonely.

Nima bo'sa bo'lar, yana bir kunim huddi shularni o'tish bilan o'tdi.
